description: This file contains an abstract PHP class 'Smarty_CacheResource_KeyValueStore' which implements a cache handler for key/value store backends in the Smarty templating system. It provides methods for populating cache metadata, reading, writing, invalidating, and managing cache locks, designed to be extended with specific storage implementations.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_KeyValueStore
classes.description: Abstract class providing a key/value store caching backend for Smarty's cache handling. Implements common cache management methods and defines abstract methods for read/write/delete operations to be specified by subclasses.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populate cache metadata from resource info and generate cache filepath.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populate cached object with timestamp and existence info fetched from store.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Process cached content for Smarty_Internal_Template, evaluate if valid.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Write rendered template output to cache with meta timestamp.

methods.name: readCachedContent
methods.description: Retrieve cached content for a template.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clear the entire cache store.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear cache for a specific template with resource name, cache id, and compile id.

methods.name: getTemplateUid
methods.description: Get unique identifier for the template source.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitize components used in cache identifiers.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Retrieve cache content and timestamp, check for invalidation.

methods.name: addMetaTimestamp
methods.description: Add current microtime as header to cache content.

methods.name: getMetaTimestamp
methods.description: Extract timestamp from cached content header.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Mark cache or part of cache as invalidated by updating invalidation keys.

methods.name: getLatestInvalidationTimestamp
methods.description: Obtain the latest invalidation timestamp across invalidation keys.

methods.name: listInvalidationKeys
methods.description: Translate a cache ID into its associated invalidation keys.

methods.name: hasLock
methods.description: Check if cache for a template is currently locked.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Lock cache for a template.

methods.name: releaseLock
methods.description: Unlock cache for a template.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Abstract method: fetch multiple cache keys' values.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Abstract method: save multiple cache keys' values.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Abstract method: delete multiple cache keys.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Purge the entire cache store (default implementation returns false).
